components.purpose: Opening section: event title as the heading, a short description, and the register button (CTA 1, linking to the form below) over a gradient background (set backgroundType to a gradient option).
The short agenda, written as free text (for example a brief list of topics and times).

The registration form. It has a configurable submit URL and success, error and loading messages. Leave the office address and phone fields empty. NewsletterSignup was the alternative, but it only collects an email for a mailing list, which is too limited for event registration.
